title: Represent Three-Dimensional Figures in Two Dimensions

items.stem: Which net can be folded to form a cube?
choices: A net with 6 squares connected in a single line
A net with 6 squares arranged in a cross shape
A net with 5 squares arranged in an L shape
A net with 4 squares arranged in a square shape

items.stem: A rectangular prism has a length of 4 units, a width of 3 units, and a height of 2 units. Which of the following nets correctly represents the rectangular prism?
choices: A net with 2 rectangles measuring 4 by 3, 2 rectangles measuring 4 by 2, and 2 rectangles measuring 3 by 2
A net with 6 squares each measuring 3 units on a side
A net with 3 rectangles each measuring 4 by 3 only
A net with 4 rectangles measuring 4 by 2 only

items.stem: Select ALL statements that correctly describe properties of a net that forms a rectangular prism. Show or explain your work.
choices: The net must have exactly 6 faces
All faces in the net must be squares
Opposite faces in the net have the same dimensions
The net can include triangles as faces

items.stem: Draw or describe a net for a square pyramid. Explain how your net can be folded to create the three-dimensional figure. Show or explain your work.
